title: Fast-forwardable Lindbladians imply quantum phase estimation
authors: Zhong-Xia Shang, **Naixu Guo** (co-first author), Patrick Rebentrost, Alán Aspuru-Guzik, Tongyang Li, Qi Zhao
venue: arXiv preprint (2025); contributed talk at QIP 2026
summary: Fast-forwardable Lindbladian dynamics can implement quantum phase estimation at the Heisenberg limit, connecting open-system simulation to a standard algorithmic primitive.

sources.note: Coauthor publication list distinguishes the QIP 2026 contributed talk.
